# Brand Guide

## Summary
Base-realm brand identity card — colors, typography, and custom CSS
variables that themes and cards can reference. Lives at
`https://cardstack.com/base/brand-guide` (default export `BrandGuide`,
extending `DetailedStyleRef`).

## API
Structured style building blocks exported by the module:
- `CompoundColorField` — a named color with variants
- `CompoundImageField` — a named image asset
- `CustomCssVariable` — a free-form `--name: value` pair

A BrandGuide instance aggregates these into a reviewable brand kit.

## Usage
Create a BrandGuide instance in the realm, then reference its values from a
Theme's `cssVariables` (see the Theme spec). No example instance here yet —
an honest one needs a real brand kit; flagged for the review pass.
